notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Clear lemon with pitted peel, stem and calyx, and a pointed nub that shows when turned, though the body is a bit lumpy and egg-like, with a good control panel that stacks on phone.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: A pale, translucent grey-white blob with radial lines that reads as an umbrella or shell rather than a lemon, and on phone the model is cropped behind the panel.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Convincing yellow lemon with a stalk stub, soft shadow, pitted peel and glossy highlights, nicely staged with clean phone layout, though the model is small on mobile and the nipple is mild.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Richly textured peel with a clear pointed nub and solid 3D under rotation, but the shape is an elongated egg and the phone layout has overlapping text and the panel covering the model.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Convincing lemon with nub, stem stub, pitted glossy peel and soft shadow, plus clean controls and a sensible phone layout, though the pointed end reads slightly pear-like.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Nicely textured peel but the shape is a plain egg whose nub only shows at some angles, and on phone the model is cropped and the overlay panel covers it.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Pale translucent blob with meridian lines that does not read as a lemon, and it is mostly hidden by the panel on mobile.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Strong lemon with nipple, calyx and stem, leaf option, pitted peel and a very thorough control panel, though the pits look a little sparse and flat.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Nicely pitted peel but the body is a near-symmetric egg with only faint nubs, and on phone the panel and readout cover the fruit.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Reads as a real lemon with stem stub, nipple, waxy highlight and soft shadow, plus clean staging and a good phone layout, though the shape is a little pear-like.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Large, convincing lemon with a pointed nipple, stem and calyx and pitted peel, a slightly flat matte look but solid geometry that holds up when orbited.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Washed-out grey-white translucent blob with meridian lines and no visible lemon shape, and the phone panel covers it.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Polished and feature-rich with a pleasing peel, but the body is a rounded egg with only a tiny nub that appears from some angles, so it reads as a melon or yellow ball more than a lemon.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Clearly a lemon with a pointed stem end, dimpled peel, warm highlight, leaf and stem, and a smooth turn; the stem end is clipped off at the canvas edge on desktop and mobile, but it is still the best lemon.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Tall, capsule-shaped body with harsh speckled pits and no pointed nub, so it looks more like a pickle or corn cob than a lemon, and the leaf placement is odd.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: A glittery, over-noisy egg with no stem nub, cluttered by overlay panels that cover the model on phone.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Tall barrel-shaped fruit with dense pitting and a leaf, but the proportions read more like a yellow pill or melon than a lemon and the nub is barely there.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: A glittery yellow egg with noisy speckles, no visible nub or stem, and the control panel overlaps the model on a phone.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Unmistakably a lemon: a proper pointed nub with a stem and leaf, soft pitted peel, a believable highlight and contact shadow, and a clean layout.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Smooth, well-lit lemon-yellow fruit that shows a real nub from some angles, but at rest it reads as a plain egg and the pitting is faint.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Egg-shaped yellow blob with harsh glittery speckle noise and no visible nub or stem; mobile layout has the panel covering the model.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Pitted, nicely lit peel but the body is a tall rounded capsule (more like a corn cob or pill) with only a faint tip, and a leaf that looks detached at the bottom.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Smooth, convincing lemon-yellow ovoid with soft shading, floor shadow and cut-open options, but the nub shows only from some angles and is mostly a round egg at rest.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Unmistakably a lemon with a clear pointed nub, stem and leaf, fine pitted peel, soft highlights and tidy controls, though the leaf clips at the viewport edge.
